name: Beat HEMA
summary:
Face your opponent with a shield in your left hand and a blade in your right. Read the wind-up, block on the beat and strike back when an opening appears.

Each opponent changes the rhythm of the fight. A fast dual-blade fighter keeps up the pressure, a sword-and-shield opponent moves between attack and defense, and a heavy guardian slams its two shields together. Duck or lean away from incoming attacks as opponents take turns entering the fight.

Choose hand tracking or Touch controllers. In hand-tracking
